backup_log_format.description: Filename pattern for transaction log backup files.

backup_log_path.description: Full path to the local directory containing transaction log backup files. Required if `backup_storage_type` is `ALTERNATE_LOCATION`

backup_storage_type.description: Location of transaction log backup files when using BACKUP binary log type. Possible values: `"AZURE"`, `"ALTERNATE_LOCATION"`, `"AWS"`, `"GCS"`, `"MSDB"`.

binary_log_truncater.description: Determine who is responsible for truncating the online transaction log. Possible values: `"FIVETRAN"`, `"USER_MANAGED"`, `"SQL_SERVER_AGENT"`. Default value is `"FIVETRAN"`.

binary_log_type.description: Source of transaction log data when using Binary Log Reader. Possible values: `"ONLINE"`, `"BACKUP"`. Default value is `"ONLINE"`.

bucket.description: The name of the S3 bucket.

connection_string.description: The Azure Blob Storage container connection string.

connection_type.description: Possible values: `Directly`, `PrivateLink`, `SshTunnel`. `SshTunnel` is used as a value if this parameter is omitted in the request and any of the following parameter's values is specified: `tunnel_host`, `tunnel_port`, `tunnel_user`. Otherwise, `Directly` is used as a value if the parameter is omitted.

container_name.description: The name of the Azure Blob Storage container.

ekm_key_identifiers.description: The list of Azure Key Vault key identifiers used for TDE. Each identifier should be in the format `https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/keys/<key-name>` or `https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/keys/<key-name>/<version>`.

external_id.description: The external ID to be used when assuming the IAM role.

host.description: DB instance host or IP address.

role_arn.description: The ARN of the IAM role that has access to the S3 bucket.

tde_certificate_backup.description: Certificate file used to protect a database encryption key. Used when decrypting backup logs.

tde_certificate_path.description: Certificate file path used to protect a database encryption key. Used when decrypting online logs

tde_password.description: Password of the TDE private key

tde_private_key_backup.description: Private key file associated with the TDE certificate. Used when decrypting backup logs.

tde_private_key_path.description: Private key file path associated with the TDE certificate. Used when decrypting online logs.

tde_setting.description: Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) setting. Possible values: `"OFF"`, `"CERTIFICATE"`. Default value is `"OFF"`.

tunnel_host.description: SSH host, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel (do not use a load balancer).

tunnel_port.description: SSH port, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

tunnel_user.description: SSH user, specify only to connect via an SSH tunnel.

update_method.description: (Optional) The incremental update method the connector will use. The possible values are `"TELEPORT"` or `"NATIVE_UPDATE"`. The type defaults to `"NATIVE_UPDATE"` if the value is set to `null` or not specified.

user.description: The user name.  For Azure Databases, the format must be `user@domain`.

windows_auth_client_certificate.description: Fivetran client certificate to add to the Windows Auth server's trusted clients.

windows_auth_grpc_host.description: Hostname of the Windows Auth gRPC server.

windows_auth_grpc_port.description: Port of the Windows Auth gRPC server.

windows_auth_server_certificate.description: PEM certificate of the Windows Auth gRPC server used to verify the server identity.

password.description: ESM key for the user's password.

user.description: ESM key for the user name
